checks.R18: All approved bodies are native VC8 C++ or C89 CRT source. No inline assembly, byte-emission bodies, binary includes, Microsoft binary copies masquerading as source or pasted decompiler implementation occur. Era CRT lineage is recorded; imports are genuine declarations from the installed headers, not fabricated replacement bodies. No rule exceptions are requested.
